info.inspired_by: Leningrad and Moscow constructivist housing of 1928-32: ribbon windows, glazed cylindrical stair drums, cantilevered balconies with tube railings, a shop on the ground floor, roof solarium

frame: x along the street front, y into the plot, z up; origin on the front line, mid-frontage, z 0 = ground at the main entrance
notes: 48 flats (corridor type) in 6 bays x 4 floors, two stairs (drum and tower), shop and laundry below
